narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Only three angles are given, so the fourth angle can be any size.
<bookmark mark='swing'/>If the fourth corner grows, the total grows past three hundred sixty.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The total must stay three hundred sixty, so the fourth angle is fixed.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble: the fourth angle can be any size; the fourth corner swings wider and the total 360 flashes; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>The four angles of any quadrilateral add to three hundred sixty degrees.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Add the known angles, then take the total away from three hundred sixty.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Three angles of a plot are seventy, eighty five and ninety five degrees. Find the fourth.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the garden; two lines: the four angles add to 360°; take the known angles away from 360°; then a new plot with angles 70°, 85°, 95° and an empty box
